scenario: Results persist and round-trip through a provider that has no filesystem representation; a fresh consumer rebuilds working state from opaque references alone.

consumer.session: fresh, no prior handles, no local cache

when: the consumer inspects the subject and reconstructs lifecycle state

reasons: planning result reported with its opaque reference and native revision
handle rebuilt from provider state on this use, not from a persisted handle
must_not: require a file, sidecar, or local database to resolve the result
persist the reconstructed handle as a durable identity
normalize the provider's reference into a foreign schema
